sources.snippet: video-mirai.mp4 This is the official PyTorch implementation of the paper "Video-Mirai: Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models Need Foresight". Causal video generators are under-constrained at the segment level: many hidden states can decode the same plausible current segment, but only some retain the identity, layout, and motion cues that future segments will need.
